thread:
alex: Heads-up — my docs PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842) fixed the /v1/generate request schema but missed a couple of examples. The Python snippet still calls `client.completions(...)` and the OpenAPI response example uses `choices`. Runtime returns `outputs`, so examples are inconsistent with the API surface. Can someone quick-review?

priya: saw it, thanks. PR looks fine for the schema change but we should update all examples (curl, python, go) and add a short migration note. I can review a follow-up commit.

ben: confirmed — this came from the runtime v2 change where we standardized on `outputs` (array of objects with `content` / `metadata`). Backends already produce `outputs`; tests assume that shape. Docs need to reflect it.

sam: I can patch the Python snippet. Proposed replacement:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("Write a haiku about latency")
print(resp.outputs[0].content)
```

alex: perfect. Also update the OpenAPI example request body — current example uses `prompt` but our schema now expects `input: string` (unified with embeddings). Change that and update the curl sample to use "Accept: application/json" and `--compressed` so it matches our style guide. Link to staging for reviewers: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/reference/generate

docs-bot: PR #842 — example fixes requested; labels: docs, needs-review. CI: pending.

priya: small nit — in the Go snippet we use `resp.Choices[0].Text` style in examples; should be `resp.Outputs[0].Content` to match the SDK naming. Also mention the migration mapping (`choices -> outputs`, `text -> content`) in the changelog entry.

sam: pushing a commit in a sec with python + curl + openapi sample changes. Will include a short note in docs/changes.md.

alex: once merged, please backport to the `stable` branch and open a tiny migration guide for customers (one paragraph + example mapping). Thanks — will mark this for the weekly docs sync agenda :tada:
